title: Polynomial length of serialized formulas
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean tape symbols, there exists $K\in\mathbb{N}$ such that for all $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$, the serialized validity, adjacency, and acceptance formulas each have length at most $K(s+n+2)^K$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
replaced:
For every finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, there is a natural number
$K$ such that, for all natural numbers $n,s$, the serialized validity formula, adjacency
formula, and acceptance formula each have length at most $K(s+n+2)^K$.
